name: Sapling
summary: A refer-a-friend panel where every invite buds a branch and every friend who joins grows it out
about: A referral card with a potted tree. Each email you invite flies to the trunk as a little envelope and becomes a bud; when the friend opens it the branch starts to grow, and when they join it shoots out with leaves and fruit and adds PKR 100. At five friends the whole tree blossoms, a ribbon ties the pot and the PKR 500 credit drops in.
how: Copy your referral link, or type a friend's email and press Invite (Enter works).
Wrong or repeated emails are caught with a short message.
Watch each invite go from Invite sent to Opened to Joined; slow friends get a Nudge button.
Five joined friends make the tree blossom and unlock the reward.
Start a new tree lets the leaves fall and keeps your first two friends.
